name: 🎬 Social Media Video Auto Publisher from Google Drive

parameters.content:
## 🎬 Social Media Video Auto Publisher from Google Drive

### What This Workflow Does
Watches a Google Drive folder → detects new video → generates AI content (OpenAI GPT-4o) → publishes to **11 destinations** automatically:
- 📘 Facebook: Page Post, Reels, Story
- 📸 Instagram: Post, Reels, Story
- ▶️ YouTube: Video, Shorts *(YouTube Stories discontinued 2023)*
- 🎵 TikTok: Video, Story

---
### ⚡ Quick Setup

**Step 1 – Create Credentials** *(Settings → Credentials)*
| # | Name | Type | Details |
|---|------|------|---------|
| 1 | Google Drive OAuth2 | Google Drive OAuth2 API | Complete OAuth flow |
| 2 | OpenAI API Key (Header Auth) | HTTP Header Auth | Header: `Authorization` Value: `Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY` |
| 3 | Facebook Page Access Token | HTTP Header Auth | Header: `Authorization` Value: `Bearer YOUR_PAGE_TOKEN` |
| 4 | YouTube OAuth2 | OAuth2 (Google) | Scope: `youtube.upload` |
| 5 | TikTok Access Token | HTTP Header Auth | Header: `Authorization` Value: `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN` |
| 6 | SMTP Email | SMTP | Your mail server |

**Step 2 – Replace Placeholders in Nodes**
- `YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID` → ID from Drive folder URL
- `YOUR_FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID` → Facebook Page numeric ID
- `YOUR_INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_USER_ID` → Instagram Business account ID
- `YOUR_ERROR_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL` → Email for error alerts

**Step 3 – Activate** *(toggle at top right)*

---
### ⚠️ Notes
- Videos must be valid MP4/MOV, recommended ≤ 500 MB
- Instagram requires a publicly accessible video URL
- Facebook Reels & Story use 3-phase binary upload (init → upload → publish)
- YouTube uses resumable upload with OAuth2
- TikTok Story API requires special app permission from TikTok

## 📘 Facebook – What You Need

### Credentials
- Facebook **Developer App** at developers.facebook.com
- **Page Access Token** (long-lived, 60 days)
- Required Permissions: `pages_manage_posts`, `pages_read_engagement`, `publish_video`

### How to Get Page Access Token
1. Go to Graph API Explorer
2. Select your App → select your Page
3. Generate User Token → Exchange for Page Token
4. Extend to long-lived token

### API Endpoints Used
| Feature | Method & Endpoint |
|---------|-------------------|
| Page Video Post | `POST /v18.0/PAGE_ID/videos` (file_url) |
| Reels – Start | `POST /v18.0/PAGE_ID/video_reels` (upload_phase=start) |
| Reels – Upload | `PUT {upload_url}` binary video |
| Reels – Publish | `POST /v18.0/PAGE_ID/video_reels` (upload_phase=finish) |
| Story – Start | `POST /v18.0/PAGE_ID/video_stories` (upload_phase=start) |
| Story – Upload | `PUT {upload_url}` binary video |
| Story – Publish | `POST /v18.0/PAGE_ID/video_stories` (upload_phase=finish) |

### Get Page ID
Facebook Page → About → Page ID (at the bottom)

## 📸 Instagram – What You Need

### Credentials
- Instagram **Business** or **Creator** account linked to a Facebook Page
- Same **Facebook Page Access Token** as above
- Permissions: `instagram_basic`, `instagram_content_publish`, `instagram_manage_media`

### API Flow for All Types
1. **Create Container** → POST to `/{IG_USER_ID}/media`
   - For Post: `media_type=VIDEO`
   - For Reels: `media_type=REELS`
   - For Story: `media_type=STORIES`
   - Returns `container_id`
2. **Wait 60 seconds** (video processing)
3. **Publish** → POST to `/{IG_USER_ID}/media_publish` with `creation_id`

### Get Instagram User ID
1. Graph API Explorer
2. Run: `GET /me?fields=id,name` with your Facebook token
3. Or: `GET /me/accounts` to list connected IG accounts

### Important
- Video URL must be **publicly accessible** (HTTPS)
- Reels: max 90 seconds, vertical preferred
- Stories: auto-expire after 24 hours

## ▶️ YouTube – What You Need

### Credentials
- Google Cloud Console project
- Enable **YouTube Data API v3**
- Create **OAuth2 Client ID** (Web App type)
- Authorized redirect: `https://YOUR_N8N_INSTANCE/rest/oauth2-credential/callback`
- Scope: `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.upload`

### Upload Flow (Resumable)
**Node 1 – Init:** `POST /upload/youtube/v3/videos?uploadType=resumable&part=snippet,status`
- Body: JSON with title, description, tags, status
- Returns: `Location` header → contains upload URL

**Node 2 – Prep:** Code node re-attaches binary data + extracts upload URL from Location header

**Node 3 – Upload:** `PUT {location_url}` with raw video binary

### YouTube Shorts
- Same upload flow as regular Video
- YouTube auto-classifies as Short if duration ≤ 60s AND vertical (9:16)
- `#Shorts` added to title automatically

### ⚠️ YouTube Stories – DISCONTINUED
YouTube Stories were shut down in June 2023. Not included in this workflow.

## 🎵 TikTok – What You Need

### Credentials
- TikTok Developer Account at developers.tiktok.com
- App with **Content Posting API** approved
- User Access Token via OAuth2
- Scopes: `video.publish`, `video.upload`

### Video Upload Flow
**Node 1 – Init:** `POST /v2/post/publish/video/init/`
- Body: post_info (title, privacy) + source_info (FILE_UPLOAD, size, chunk)
- Returns: `upload_url` + `publish_id`

**Node 2 – Prep:** Code node re-attaches binary + extracts upload URL

**Node 3 – Upload:** `PUT {upload_url}` binary video with Content-Range header

### Story Upload Flow
- Uses `POST /v2/post/publish/content/init/`
- Requires separate **Story permission** approval from TikTok

### Privacy Levels
`PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` | `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` | `SELF_ONLY`

### ⚠️ Note
TikTok Story API requires special permission approval. Contact TikTok developer support.
